# FlowMap { #timetoalign.timelines.FlowMap }

```python
timelines.FlowMap(
    timeline,
    chunks,
    *,
    id=None,
    seed=None,
    _unknown_keys=dict[str, Any](),
    convention=None,
    canonical=False,
    name=None,
    provenance=(),
)
```

One order in which stretches of one root timeline are played.

The FlowMap as it is written: it names its chunks and holds no
interval. :meth:`resolve` reads it against its root timeline.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name       | Type                                                                              | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
|------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| timeline   | [str](`str`)                                                                      | The ID of the ONE root timeline whose stretches are played.                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| chunks     | [tuple](`tuple`)\[[str](`str`) \| [Gap](`timetoalign.core.Gap`), ...\]            | The chunks in the order played. Each is the ID of a Region of the root or of a descendant, of a child timeline at any depth, or of a virtual timeline of that tree, or a :class:`~timetoalign.core.Gap`. A chunk may occur any number of times; the root itself is no chunk. |
| convention | [FlowConvention](`timetoalign.core.enums.FlowConvention`) \| [str](`str`) \| None | Which flow of the timeline's flow control the FlowMap states: ``default``, ``single`` or ``printed`` (:class:`~timetoalign.core.enums.FlowConvention`); any other word is kept as given. None on a FlowMap that follows none, such as one written by hand.                   |
| canonical  | [bool](`bool`)                                                                    | Whether this is the canonical FlowMap of its timeline.                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| name       | [str](`str`) \| None                                                              | Optional display name.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| provenance | [tuple](`tuple`)\[[Provenance](`timetoalign.core.provenance.Provenance`), ...\]   | How the FlowMap was made and who believes it: any number of :class:`~timetoalign.core.provenance.Provenance` entries, as the manifest lists them.                                                                                                                            |
| id         | [str](`str`)                                                                      | The FlowMap's ID; minted with the prefix ``flow`` when not given.                                                                                                                                                                                                            |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                                                                   |
|--------|----------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the timeline or a chunk is no valid ID, a chunk names the timeline itself or is neither an ID nor a gap, or a provenance entry is invalid. |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> from timetoalign.core import Gap
>>> reading = FlowMap("score", ["b", Gap(4), "a"], seed=7)
>>> reading.id, reading.convention, reading.canonical
('flow_1hvif5xc2r1fv', None, False)
>>> FlowMap.from_dict(reading.to_dict()) == reading
True
```

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [from_dict](#timetoalign.timelines.FlowMap.from_dict) | Restore a FlowMap from its object in a manifest's ``flow_maps``. |
| [resolve](#timetoalign.timelines.FlowMap.resolve) | Read the FlowMap against its root timeline. |

### from_dict { #timetoalign.timelines.FlowMap.from_dict }

```python
timelines.FlowMap.from_dict(data)
```

Restore a FlowMap from its object in a manifest's ``flow_maps``.

IDs are bare, as every object of the library holds them. A chunk is
an ID or the object ``{gap: length}``, the length read as its JSON
form says (an integer, a float, a Fraction pair). ``convention``,
``canonical``, ``name`` and ``provenance`` may be left out. Keys the
library does not know are kept, a gap's too, and written back.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                                                | Description         | Default    |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------------|---------------------|------------|
| data   | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] | The FlowMap object. | _required_ |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                 |
|--------|----------------------------|-----------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the object is malformed. |

### resolve { #timetoalign.timelines.FlowMap.resolve }

```python
timelines.FlowMap.resolve(root)
```

Read the FlowMap against its root timeline.

Each chunk becomes its interval on the ROOT's axis: a Region its
extent, a child timeline its whole length, each carried up to the
root by the offsets of the timelines between (exact offset
arithmetic); a virtual timeline of the tree the stretches of the
FlowMap it applies, in their order. A gap keeps its length. The
stretches are placed one after the other on the virtual axis.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                                              | Description                     | Default    |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------|------------|
| root   | [Timeline](`timetoalign.timelines.base.Timeline`) | The timeline the FlowMap names. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                    | Description                      |
|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------|
|        | [ResolvedFlowMap](`timetoalign.timelines.flow.flowmap.ResolvedFlowMap`) | The FlowMap as placed stretches. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                                                                  | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`)                                            | If *root* is a child timeline or not the timeline named; a chunk names nothing in the root's tree; a chunk is a virtual timeline whose unit is not the root's (every region and child of a tree is in the root's unit), or one that cannot be read (it applies no FlowMap of the root, another timeline than the root's, or goes ``through`` something); a gap's length is no value of the root's number type; or the chunks name one another in a circle. |
|        | [UnknownLengthError](`timetoalign.timelines.base.UnknownLengthError`) | If a child timeline named has no known length.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
